details.description: Ministral 3 3B is the smallest model in Mistral AI's Ministral 3 family, an edge-optimized model line released December 2, 2025 under the Apache 2.0 license. It pairs a 3.4B-parameter language model with a 0.4B-parameter vision encoder for combined text and image input. The instruction-tuned FP8 build supports native function calling and JSON-constrained output, and Mistral says it can be deployed locally in as little as 8GB of VRAM in FP8, or less when further quantized, on a single H200 GPU.
advantages: Scores 83.0% on MATH Maj@1 and 56.8 on WildBench, per Mistral's instruct-model benchmark table on its Hugging Face model card.
Scores an Arena Hard score of 30.5 and 7.83 on MM MTBench (multimodal chat), per the same benchmark table.
Mistral says it can be deployed locally in as little as 8GB of VRAM in FP8, and less when further quantized.
Supports native function calling and JSON-constrained output, per its Hugging Face model card.
Released under the Apache 2.0 license, allowing commercial and derivative use.
disadvantages: Smallest model in the Ministral 3 family; scores lower than the 8B and 14B siblings on every benchmark in Mistral's own instruct comparison table.
Text and image input only; Mistral's model card does not describe audio or video input support.
use_cases: Lightweight, real-time chat on edge or low-resource devices
Image captioning and other combined vision-and-text tasks
Real-time translation and short content generation

notes: Bud's catalog id 'ministral-3-3b-2512' does not literally match Mistral's own advertised La Plateforme API id for this model, which its docs page lists as 'ministral-3b-2512' (alias 'ministral-3b-latest'), with no '-3-' infix anywhere in that page's alias list. Treated as the same Ministral 3 3B model based on matching size (3B), the '2512'/v25.12 release wave, provider (mistral), and the fact no other Mistral model of this name and date exists. The catalog's 131,072-token (128K) input/output limits were kept as authoritative, but this is a real conflict, not just a naming one: both Mistral's docs page and its Hugging Face model card explicitly state a 256K-token context window for this model ('Large Context Window: Supports a 256k context window').
